description: Find property_id using fuzzy address matching. Billed per field, per home returned. Handles typos, abbreviations, partial addresses. Pass country_abbreviation to keep every match in one country. Use returned property_id with other endpoints for detailed data.

country_abbreviation.description: Only return matches from one country, by its country_abbreviation as location_endpoint returns it (for example "GB"). Default: every country. A query that names a province, a state, or a postal code already ranks its own country first.

exclude.description: Source classes to leave out, comma separated, such as "inferred" or "inferred,observed". Checks the selected fields that have a source column, keeps a match when one of them keeps its value, and empties the rest.

price_quote.description: Return the cost of this request without billing it or returning data

query.description: Address query. Handles partial addresses, building names, typos. Include city for better accuracy.

name: search_endpoint
